# Parse/prepare + verification for recipients and attachment, then send email.

# Login file_system (for attachment)
fs_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='file_system'][0]
fs_login = apis.file_system.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=fs_pw)
fs_token = fs_login['access_token']

# Login gmail
gmail_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='gmail'][0]
gmail_login = apis.gmail.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=gmail_pw)
gmail_token = gmail_login['access_token']

# Attachment path (from prior compression)
attachment_path = '/home/erica/photographs/childhood_pics/childhood_pics.tar'

# Fetch phone contacts (identity resolution)
phone_pw = [p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_login = apis.phone.login(username='4675246489', password=phone_pw)
phone_token = phone_login['access_token']

all_contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_contacts.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index > 200:
        break

# Extract parent candidates using relationships
mother_candidates = [c for c in all_contacts if 'mother' in (c.get('relationships') or [])]
father_candidates = [c for c in all_contacts if 'father' in (c.get('relationships') or [])]

# If relationship tags are missing, fall back to generic 'parent'
if not mother_candidates:
    mother_candidates = [c for c in all_contacts if 'parent' in (c.get('relationships') or [])]
if not father_candidates:
    father_candidates = [c for c in all_contacts if 'parent' in (c.get('relationships') or [])]

print('num_phone_contacts', len(all_contacts))
print('mother_candidates', len(mother_candidates))
print('father_candidates', len(father_candidates))

# Disambiguation guard: if multiple, exclude ambiguity (do not guess)
if len(mother_candidates) != 1 or len(father_candidates) != 1:
    print('AMBIGUITY_UNRESOLVED: mother_candidates=', [(c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c.get('email'), c.get('relationships')) for c in mother_candidates],
          'father_candidates=', [(c['first_name'], c['last_name'], c.get('email'), c.get('relationships')) for c in father_candidates])
    raise Exception('Ambiguous parent identity; refusing to send email.')

mother = mother_candidates[0]
father = father_candidates[0]

recipients = [mother.get('email'), father.get('email')]
# Ensure non-empty
recipients = [r for r in recipients if r]

print('Recipients to email:', recipients)

print('Verification table (Recipient | email | relationships):')
for c in [mother, father]:
    print(c['first_name'], c['last_name'], '|', c.get('email'), '|', c.get('relationships'))

# Criteria table (per task)
print('\nCriteria:')
print('1) Attachment: tar at', attachment_path, '(from "~/photographs/childhood_pics/" compressed)')
print('2) Recipients: both parents via phone contacts (mother tag + father tag)')
print('3) Subject: "Childhood Memories"')
print('4) Body: "Checkout attachments."')

# Send email (irreversible)
subject = 'Childhood Memories'
body = 'Checkout attachments.'

resp = apis.gmail.send_email(
    email_addresses=recipients,
    subject=subject,
    body=body,
    access_token=gmail_token,
    attachment_file_paths=[attachment_path],
